name: Everyday Materials Quiz
description: Ten questions about the stuff that things around you are made from.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Ten multiple-choice questions about everyday materials, shown on Quick Quiz.
help.goal: Just for fun. Answer what you like; your score is shown only to you.
howToPlay: Read the question and choose an answer.
A short explanation follows each answer.
Press Next question to carry on.
At the end, Play again gives a fresh shuffle.
tips: Wrong answers are part of the fun, and nothing is recorded anywhere else.
